title: Infer migration outcome from separate change notices

origin.notes: Original synthetic case; no adaptation. Held-out: excluded from the development loop.

world.description: Fictional home-lab run by user Alex. Hosts: thor (NAS), valkyrie (compute). All entities and values are invented for benchmark use.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: The media library is being moved from thor to valkyrie on July 1.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: The move is done. Media library files are now on valkyrie.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: For reference, the old NAS share is called media-legacy.
setup.note: Historical share name; not where media lives now.

probe.text: Where does the media library currently live?

expected.correct: on valkyrie (moved from thor on July 1)
expected.rationale: The current location must be inferred by combining the migration announcement with the completion notice. The legacy share name is a distractor and must not be given as the current home of the media library.
